say:1:1029228001:1.text: Do you see the beauty of absolute power? If you persevere in your special training, you'll be much stronger than you are now, even if you'll never be as strong as me!
say:1:1029228001:1.source_cn: 见识到绝对力量的魅力了吗？如果坚持特训的话，你们虽然不...

say:2:1029228002:1.text: All treasures disappear eventually. Only power will never betray you!
say:2:1029228002:1.source_cn: 不管什么宝物，最终都会消失，只有力量永远不会背叛！

say:3:1029228003:2.text: Uh... You're totally correct! You can't rely on treasures or whatever!
say:3:1029228003:2.source_cn: 呃……沙奎尔老大说得太对了！宝物什么的根本就靠不住啊！

say:4:1029228004:1.text: Not bad. Seems like you're finally able to grasp my teachings.
say:4:1029228004:1.source_cn: 不错。看来你终于能意识到力量的重要性了。

say:5:1029228005:1.text: So... Boss, what do you think about this? We'll sell this treasure together and give you some of the profits, and then you'll just forget you ever saw us. How about it?
say:5:1029228005:1.source_cn: 所以……沙奎尔老大，你看这样如何？我们一起卖掉这个宝物...

say:7:1029228007:1.text: Well, how about you take a third? Can't get much better than that—you don't even have to do anything, but you'll get a third of the profits!
say:7:1029228007:1.source_cn: 那，我们分你三分之一，如何？很够意思了吧，你什么事都不...

say:8:1029228008:1.text: You... blockhead! You really think I can be bought off as easily as you?!
say:8:1029228008:1.source_cn: 你这个……蠢货！你以为我和你们一样，会因为这点钱就被收买吗！

choice_prompt:9:1029228008.text: You... blockhead! You really think I can be bought off as easily as you?!
choice_prompt:9:1029228008.source_cn: 你这个……蠢货！你以为我和你们一样，会因为这点钱就被收买吗！

say:10:1029228009:3.text: Say what you like; there's no way I'm going back to training! You'd have to drag me back in chains!
say:10:1029228009:3.source_cn: 随便你们怎么说，反正我是绝对不会回去继续训练的！除非你...

say:11:1029228010:1.text: Who'd want to do this if it wasn't for the money?! Your dumb special training almost killed me. If it wasn't to make a little money, why would people even train?!
say:11:1029228010:1.source_cn: 要不是为了钱，谁要做这一行啊！你那什么破特训，训得命都...

say:12:1029228011:3.text: Boss, don't listen to their nonsense. I've got the perfect plan, which you definitely won't regret.
say:12:1029228011:3.source_cn: 沙奎尔老大，你别听他们乱说。我有一个完美的计划，一定不...

say:13:1029228012:1.text: Since you're stronger than even the three of us put together... Wouldn't it be easy to just take these two out of the equation?
say:13:1029228012:1.source_cn: 既然你这么强，比我们三个加起来都厉害……那要是让你消灭...

say:14:1029228013:1.text: Of course! You realize the value of strength, which means you're already better than these two!
say:14:1029228013:1.source_cn: 那是当然。你还能意识到力量的价值，已经比他们两个优秀了！

say:15:1029228014:1.text: In that case, if you get rid of those two, then we can split the profits 50-50. How about it? Isn't that a good deal?
say:15:1029228014:1.source_cn: 所以，沙奎尔老大，你把剩下那两个家伙都消灭了，然后由我...

say:16:1029228015:1.text: You... idiotic morons! I trained you with the best intentions in the world, hoping you'll rid yourselves of all this weakness...
say:16:1029228015:1.source_cn: 你们这些……这些愚不可及的家伙！我好心好意训练你们，想...

say:17:1029228016:1.text: I never thought that the only thing you wanted from the very beginning was just gold!
say:17:1029228016:1.source_cn: 没想到你们真正想要的，从一开始就只是金钱而已！

say:19:1029228018:2.text: You're... a total disappointment! I don't even care anymore and have no wish to try teaching you anything ever again. It's your loss.
say:19:1029228018:2.source_cn: 你们……你们太让我失望了！已经无所谓了，我不会再试图教...

say:20:1029228019:1.text: I'm going back to camp now to train true warriors!
say:20:1029228019:1.source_cn: 我现在就回营地，去教导真正的勇士！

say:23:1029228020:1.text: True warriors...? He can't mean the remaining treasure thieves in the camp, right?
say:23:1029228020:1.source_cn: 诶，他说的“真正的勇士”……不会是营地里剩下的盗宝贼们吧……

choice:9:0:1.text: That's how you think to bribe Shakir?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 用这种方式收买沙奎尔吗？
